Schedule: The role does not follow a fixed schedule and may be

assigned to AM or PM shifts within Pacific Standard Time (PST). Example shift hours

may include 5:00 AM to 2:00 PM PST, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PST, or 12:00 PM to 9:00

PM PST. The schedule will be communicated in advance and follows a 5x2 work

pattern.


Starting date: ASAP


At Mindy Support you have great opportunity to get:


  • Experience in the international company working with people around the globe;
  • Compensation : $650 during 3 months of probation; $650 (after trial period) + 50$ bonus for KPIs | A Loyalty Bonus is offered based on the achievement of KPIs and attendance requirements. The bonus increases over time in recognition of consistent performance, reliability, and tenure..
  • Training will be provided by the company and the client;
  • Dynamic work in a young team of like-minded people;
  • Management's attention, support and motivation.


The Vehicle Inspector role provides vehicle inspections for customers. Vehicle Inspectors will work in an online environment to provide vehicle inspections via video chat. Having live interaction with

ride share drivers, those with good customer service skills, ability to multitask and can

learn quickly will excel in the Vehicle Inspector role.

AREAS OF FOCUS

● Customer Service

● Vehicle Inspections

● Internal communication


RESPONSIBILITIES:


- Initiate video calls with drivers at their scheduled appointment time.

- Camera must remain on during all inspections with the company background

applied. Maintain a professional appearance; casual but neat attire is required.

- Explain the inspection process clearly and concisely.

- Answer basic questions related to the inspection or redirect to the appropriate team

when necessary.

- Verify the driver’s identity and confirm their inspection request.

- Guide the driver step-by-step in positioning their phone or camera to show the

necessary parts of the vehicle.

- Exterior and interior of the vehicle (including tires, lights, mirrors, seat belts, horn,

and other key points)

- Observe and assess the condition of each required inspection point to determine

whether the vehicle meets compliance standards.

- Communicate the pass/fail result to the driver and provide a brief explanation if the

vehicle fails.

- Record the inspection outcome (Pass, Fail, or No-Show) in the internal system

immediately after the appointment.


You are our perfect candidate if you are:


●A good communicator, excelent English speaking and writing;

●C1 level of Spanish language

●C1 level of English language

● Rideshare inspection knowledge a plus

● Able to multitask with attention to detail

● Customer service experience

● Good with technology

● Able to work alongside team members in an online environment

● Inspectors must have their own computer, smartphone and strong wifi service

●Are client-oriented and attentive to details, have active listening skills, problem solver, hard-

working, team-player.

●Self-employment. We will sign a contract with you as with independent businessman;

●You can work from home, don’t be distracted;


Mindy Support is a global company. We empower businesses all over the world through providing remote assistants and outsourced teams specialized in customer support, tech support, back office activities, and agile sales and marketing support.


We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.


We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy Support!

title: Account Executive (IGaming)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a driven, curious individual to join our client's team as an Account Executive.

In this role, you will work closely with the Account Management team, supporting the growth and management of key client relationships while gaining practical experience and building a strong foundation in account management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the day-to-day management of client accounts, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness
  • Work alongside senior team members to understand client objectives and contribute to solutions that improve engagement and retention
  • Coordinate with internal teams such as product, marketing, compliance, and tech to ensure seamless delivery and client satisfaction
  • Assist in tracking and analysing client performance, identifying patterns and opportunities for optimisation
  • Ensure all client-related activities align with regulatory standards and responsible gaming principles
  • Support adherence to compliance frameworks and responsible gaming policies across all client interactions

Requirements

  • Previous experience in sales or account management (B2B) in the iGaming industry
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to build and maintain relationships
  • Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and extract insights
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Fluency in English

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
Somos a CG/lab da CAR Group – um espaço onde ideias se transformam em soluções inteligentes - moldando o futuro de como as pessoas compram e vendem veículos, uma inovação de cada vez.

Aqui, dados encontram o design, a lógica encontra a imaginação e o progresso é construído por meio da experimentação. Agimos com rapidez, mantemos a curiosidade e acreditamos que a inovação acontece quando a inteligência natural e a artificial trabalham juntas.

Impulsionados pela CAR Group , uma das maiores empresas de capital aberto da Austrália, fazemos parte de um portfólio global de empresas líderes em marketplaces de veículos , abrangendo Austrália, América Latina, América do Norte, Coreia do Sul e outros países – incluindo a Webmotors no Brasil.

Na CG/lab, geramos impacto real para nossos clientes em todo o mundo . Aqui, você não apenas contribui. Você lidera. Você experimenta. Você cria.

Vem com a gente fazer parte de algo grandioso!

#SejaParteImportanteDeAlgoGrandioso #BEABIGPARTOFSOMETHINGBIG


Sobre a posição:

Garantir a qualidade em sistemas de IA Generativa é um desafio único: as respostas podem ser não-determinísticas. Sua missão será desenhar e implementar estratégias de testes que validem não apenas o código, mas a precisão, segurança e confiabilidade dos nossos sistemas agênticos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia de Testes de IA: Criar frameworks para validar saídas de LLMs, combatendo alucinações, vieses e garantindo a aderência ao contexto.
  • Automação: Desenvolver e manter scripts de automação de testes (E2E, API e Integração) utilizando ferramentas como Playwright ou Cypress.
  • Shift-left Testing: Atuar desde a fase de requisitos para garantir que a qualidade seja pensada no início do desenvolvimento.
  • Testes de Performance e Segurança: Validar a resiliência das integrações com modelos de IA e a segurança contra vulnerabilidades como prompt injection.
  • Monitoramento de Qualidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade e bugs, reportando resultados para o time global.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência avançada em automação de testes e ferramentas de QA.
  • Conhecimento em Python (para scripts de teste e validação de dados).
  • Inglês Avançado: Capacidade de interagir e reportar resultados para times internacionais.


Desejável : Experiência anterior testando aplicações que consomem APIs de LLM (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).


Informações adicionais:

Um novo capítulo, com a excelência que você já conhece!

Na CG/lab, estamos em um momento de construção acelerada . Como uma startup recém-nascida dentro do ecossistema da CAR Group, estamos estruturando nossos processos administrativos e societários com foco em agilidade e inovação .


Valorizamos e promovemos um ambiente diverso , seguro e inclusivo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem realmente é – com autonomia, respeito e senso de pertencimento .

Nosso modelo de trabalho é presencial na Rua Gomes de Carvalho, 1.996 – 20º andar , Vila Olímpia, São Paulo/SP.

Um espaço colaborativo, moderno e cheio de conexões – onde ideias ganham força e evoluem para gerar impacto real .

Você também terá acesso à rede e ao alcance global da CAR Group – conectando você a líderes do setor e especialistas em diversos mercados – além da oportunidade de se candidatar a programas como a CAR Group Tour , que oferece a chance de vivenciar nossas operações globais e aprender com as melhores práticas de diferentes regiões.

Estamos criando algo novo, rápido e global . Se você quer o desafio de uma startup com a segurança de um grupo líder mundial, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem acelerar o futuro com a gente!

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview
As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.
  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles
  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Consultor de Projetos e Regulatório
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Liderar e estruturar projetos estratégicos, regulatórios e iniciativas especiais alinhadas ao planejamento corporativo, garantindo impacto mensurável em receita, eficiência operacional, experiência do cliente e / ou temas regulatórios;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar business cases, incluindo análise de viabilidade econômica, projeções de ROI, riscos e impactos regulatórios;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo dos projetos (inciação, planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento), assegurando cumprimento de escopo, prazo, orçamento e qualidade;
  • Liderar inciativas de transformação e melhoria de processos, incluindo automação, revisão de fluxos operacionais e integração de sistemas;
  • Garantir aderência às exigências regulatórias aplicáveis a empresa, incluindo mas não limitando-se a SUSEP e CNSP;
  • Coordernar equipes multidisciplinares (Negócios, Operações, TI, Compliance, Atuarial, Financeiro, outras), promovendo alinhamento e governança adequada;
  • Implementar e fortalecer modelos de governança e acompanhamento de portfólio de projetos, com definição de KPIs, rituais executivos e reportes quando a eventuais riscos a serem mitigados;
  • Desenvolver e implantar mecanismos na companhia que possibilitem monitorar a tempestividade e qualidade das entregas regulatórias, não limitadas ao mercado segurador mas como entidade.

Requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Administração, Direito, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento do Mercado de Seguros (produtos, fluxos operacionais, canais de distribuição);
  • Conhecimento de regulação SUSEP e CNSP;
  • Habilidades voltadas para planejamento estratégico, OKRs, metodologias de projetos, PMO, análise de impacto e viabilidade;
  • Capacidade de liderar iniciativas transversais;
  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial.


A Seguradora para um mundo em mudança


Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 30 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 9.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.


Oferecemos soluções inovadoras por meio de parcerias estratégicas em setores como Bancos, Auto, Varejo e Digital, somos referência em seguros massificados no país. Com mais de 23 milhões de certificados ativos e mais de 1,2 milhão de novas apólices mensais, alcançamos um faturamento de R$ 3,8 bilhões em 2024.


Nossa distribuição de produtos é realizada por meio dos canais de distribuição dos nossos parceiros, físicos e online. Estamos sempre preparados para atender às necessidades de um mundo em constante transformação.

Temos a missão de potencializar nossas parcerias porque, por meio delas, protegemos brasileiros. Faremos isso com uma Proposta de Valor sólida, escalável e sustentável, assegurada por times protagonistas e engajados, sob uma cultura de alta performance.


Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

description:

Buscamos um Closer com mentalidade de dono, foco em resultado e alta capacidade de execução. Ambiente meritocrático, com alta exigência e ganhos proporcionais à performance.


Vaga PJ



Remuneração e Metas

Período de Experiência

  • Fixo: R$ 2.000
  • Meta: R$ 150.000
  • Ticket médio: R$ 35.000

→ 4 a 5 vendas batem a meta

→ 100% da meta dobra o fixo

→ Aceleradores progressivos para overperformance

  • Fixo: R$ 3.000 a R$3500,00

  • Operação forte de social selling
  • 2 a 3 calls/dia
  • Conversão média esperada: ~30%

→ Potencial de 2 a 3 vendas por semana


Crescimento

  • 3 meses consecutivos batendo meta = promoção
  • Aumento de fixo + meta
  • Crescimento acelerado por mérito


Cultura

Alta performance, disciplina e cobrança.

Liberdade financeira é consequência da execução.


Perfil

  • Experiência como Closer (preferência: mercado digital)
  • Forte habilidade em fechamento e vendas consultivas
  • Alta competitividade e resiliência a metas agressivas
  • Autogestão e consistência


Diferenciais:

  • Vendas high ticket
  • Experiência com funis de webinário

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager with a strong background in SAP project implementations to lead and manage complex SAP initiatives. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in SAP Project Management, a technology-related academic background, and good English skills for daily conversation and interaction with global teams .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage SAP implementation projects , ensuring alignment with business objectives, scope, schedule, cost, and quality.
  • Apply SAP Project Management best practices , focused on SAP implementation, rollout, and transformation projects.
  • Coordinate and manage cross-functional teams , including functional, technical, and business stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines, and milestones , ensuring accurate tracking and reporting.
  • Manage risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Prepare and present status reports, dashboards, and steering committee updates .
  • Facilitate project governance, decision-making, and stakeholder communication.
  • Ensure compliance with internal methodologies, standards, and quality processes.
  • Work closely with global teams and clients, supporting collaboration across regions.


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Project Management , with strong exposure to SAP projects .
  • Proven experience in SAP Project Management , specialized in SAP implementation projects .
  • Academic degree in Technology (Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields).
  • Solid understanding of SAP delivery models and project lifecycle.
  • Experience working with multicultural and distributed teams .
  • Knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies .
  • Good English skills for conversation , meetings, and collaboration with international stakeholders.


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Continuous professional development and constant evolution of your skills, aligned with your interests.
  • Opportunities to work outside Brazil and gain international experience.
  • A collaborative, diverse, and innovative environment that encourages teamwork and inclusion.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and a global leader in innovative IT solutions, with offices in London, UK, and a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in transformative, future-ready solutions, including Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud and database technologies. Backed by over 45+ technology experts and led by visionary leadership, MillionLogics delivers tailored and results-driven technology solutions. Committed to empowering organizations worldwide, the company embraces innovation and excellence to drive digital transformation. To learn more, visit: millionlogics.com.


Role Overview

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Offer Details :

  • Contract Duration : 12 months
  • Pay : US $200 (take-home) per task
  • Experience : 5+ years
  • Position : 5
  • Work Mode : Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualification:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar)


Nice to Have

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round.


How to Apply: Please send us your updated CV to with Job ID- 72132 as your email subject.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst to join our Analyst team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language, and oriented to provide the best experience to the end-user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Analyze end-user requirements to define and document test plans.

- Execute test cases, debug, detect errors and/or possible improvements, document them, and follow up to be resolved.

- Generate reports of test results and errors detected.

- Define priorities and plan tests of system requirements.

- Document the functionalities of the systems.

- Represent the end-user to the developers to ensure that the requirements are met.

- Detect and propose improvements in both the quality control process and the software development cycle.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in testing Web Products.

- Solid knowledge of testing tools.

- Development of test plans: the creation of test cases and debugging.

- Additional knowledge in Web technologies.

- Extensive knowledge of Unix and Linux environments.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de BI Pleno - PJ
description:
Com 60 anos de história , somos pioneiros na indústria de moda íntima no Brasil e expandimos nossa atuação para as linhas fitness e beachwear , sempre com foco em inovação e excelência. Seguimos crescendo com marcas como Hope , Hope Resort e Bonjour Lingerie .

Nossa missão é clara: oferecer produtos que acompanhem as pessoas em todos os momentos da vida , com conforto, qualidade e estilo como pilares.

Mais do que vestir bem, queremos cuidar bem . Valorizamos uma cultura onde as pessoas estão no centro das decisões, guiadas por valores que fortalecem nosso propósito:

➡️ Amor como base

➡️ Ética como guia

➡️ Respeito, representatividade e autenticidade como compromissos diários

Somos movidos pela esperança e guiados por um propósito coletivo: estar ao lado das pessoas e dos negócios para que possam prosperar . Se você acredita em um ambiente que estimula o crescimento, respeita a diversidade e abre espaço para o protagonismo, o seu lugar pode ser aqui.

Venha construir sua carreira conosco.

#MovidosPelaEsperança ✨


O que você vai fazer:

  • Realizar sustentação na ferramenta de ETL Pentaho;
  • Prestar suporte aos usuários de BI nos painéis existentes;
  • Desenvolvimento de novos painéis em Power BI;
  • Desenvolvimento de querys avançadas (views, procedures, triggers);
  • Extração de dados SQL, Processo de ETL e modelagem de dados;
  • Administrar servidor do ETL para garantir que os JOBs sejam executados corretamente;
  • Manter todos os painéis e estrutura de ETL, DW em pleno funcionamento.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação Superior Completa em Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • SQL Avançado;
  • PowerBI avançado;
  • Conhecimento em PowerQuery e DAX;
  • Conhecimento em ETL Pentaho e ETL Apache Hop.



O que oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Desconto em produtos das marcas do Grupo HOPE (HOPE, HOPE Resort e Bonjour Lingerie);
  • Parcerias com descontos nos serviços: Totalpass (academias de ginastica), Vittude (aplicativo de terapia com Psicólogos) e New Value (faculdades, escola de idiomas e restaurantes);
  • Dress code flexível: somos uma empresa de moda! Valorizamos as diferenças e o estilo de cada um.


Buscamos a construção de ambiente diverso e inclusivo, por isso valorizamos as diferenças (gênero, pessoa com deficiência, LGBTQIA+, raça, etnia e diversidade etária).

title: EOI EX Electrical inspector
description:
Position: EOI EX Electrical Inspector

Location: Europe

SGS is mobilizing resources for an upcoming project and is looking for qualified professionals to join us as Freelancers or Full-Time Employees . If you have strong experience in inspection, engineering, or technical field services—this opportunity is for you.


Certification Required:

  • Valid CompEx and/or IECEx Certification (mandatory)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct field inspections and verification activities as per project requirements
  • Ensure compliance with international safety and technical standards
  • Prepare inspection reports and maintain documentation records
  • Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely completion of tasks
  • Follow SGS quality, safety, and compliance protocols

Requirements:

  • Valid CompEx / IECEx certification
  • Prior experience in inspection, field services, or technical evaluations
  • Strong understanding of safety and compliance standards
  • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision
  • Good communication and reporting skills

To Apply, Please Share at :

  • Updated Resume
  • Relevant Certificates (including CompEx/IECEx)
  • Current Location
  • Day Rate (USD)
  • Monthly Rate
  • Availability


Thanks & Regards

title: Assistente Paralegal
description:
Sobre a oportunidade


No Marques & Oliveira Advogados, buscamos um(a) Paralegal altamente organizado(a) para apoiar nossa equipe de Societário e Contratos. Organização é nosso principal diferencial: aqui, você será o pilar que mantém processos fluidos, prazos impecáveis e tudo no lugar certo.

Se você ama planilhas, checklists e controle de versões, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades principais 

  • Organizar e controlar pipeline de contratos e atos societários (cadastros, minutas, assinaturas, renovações). 
  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão de documentos (atas, procurações, aditivos, NDAs). 
  • Manter calendários de prazos, relatórios mensais e dashboards em sistema.
  • Coletar e conferir documentação para juntas comerciais, cartórios e demais órgãos.
  • Realizar e acompanhar protocolos externos, físicos e digitais, junto a órgãos públicos e privados;
  • Padronizar templates e relatórios com Visual Law.
  • Apoiar negociações e elaborações simples e arquivamento digital seguro.


Requisitos essenciais 

  • Formação em Direito ou Administração (cursando ou concluído) ou Técnico Paralegal. 
  • Expertise em organização: experiência comprovada com processos, planilhas e sistemas.
  • Conhecimento básico de societário (alterações, atas) e contratos (cláusulas padrão). 
  • Pacote Office avançado e disciplina com drive compartilhado. 
  • Proatividade e atenção a detalhes, organização acima de tudo!

O que oferecemos 

Modelo híbrido: 3 dias presenciais (SP) + 2 remotos. 

Remuneração compatível com o mercado + benefícios (VR/VT)

Mentoria com advogados e especialistas, ambiente colaborativo. 


Como se candidatar

Envie CV + exemplo de planilha/processo organizado para com assunto:

\"Paralegal Societário/Contratos — (Seu Nome)\".


Obs. Os cv's recebidos sem o exemplo de planilha/processo organizado serão desconsiderados.

title: Técnico  Segurança do Trabalho
description:
‼️Modelo: Presencial

Previsão de início: Março

⏳Duração do projeto: Aproximadamente 3 meses


1. Objeto da Contratação


  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança e legislação trabalhista vigente.
  • Reporte direto ao setor de Segurança do Trabalho da unidade.

Responsabilidades Técnicas

  • Recolhimento de ART específica e cumprimento das obrigações legais (INSS, normas trabalhistas).
  • Atendimento às normas da ABNT, NRs do MTE e legislações aplicáveis à indústria alimentícia.

Atividades Operacionais

  • Emissão de permissões de trabalho.
  • Inspeção de ferramentas utilizadas na obra.
  • Inspeção de EPI’s dos colaboradores terceirizados.
  • Condução de DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança).
  • Realização de treinamentos de segurança conforme orientação do SESMT.
  • Acompanhamento integral das atividades de manutenção e terceiros envolvidos na obra.

Integração e Comunicação

  • Relacionamento direto com a equipe de manutenção e prestadores de serviço.
  • Submissão de alterações de métodos ou materiais ao responsável técnico da JBS Seara para aprovação.
  • Entrega de relatórios e documentação exigida pela unidade.

Resultados Esperados

  • Garantia de segurança nas atividades da obra.
  • Conformidade com normas técnicas e legais.
  • Redução de riscos e acidentes.
  • Treinamento e conscientização contínua dos colaboradores terceirizados.

title: Técnico de Seguros Jr. (Seguro Garantia)
description:
Sobre a Lockton

Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Responsável pela colocação do risco do segmento de Garantia (tradicional, judicial e fiança locatícia) de seguros novos, renovações e endossos.
  • Acompanhará todo o processo, desde o cadastro do cliente até a emissão da apólice.
  • Interface com a área comercial para realizar suporte técnico, captar informações necessárias para colocação do risco e devolução da proposta.
  • Eventualmente participará de reunião com clientes e comerciais.
  • Imputará informações nos sistemas internos.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em seguro Garantia Estruturada, Tradicional, Judicial.
  • Experiência em seguradora ou corretora.

title: Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior NODE
description:
Esperado para o cargo

Atuar como referência técnica fundamental dentro da squad, focando na execução de tarefas de alta complexidade com autonomia e qualidade. Espera-se que este profissional garanta a estabilidade e a performance das aplicações Back-end (Node.js), dissemine boas práticas de engenharia (como Clean Code e SOLID) através de Code Reviews rigorosos e atue como mentor técnico para desenvolvedores de níveis Júnior e Pleno, elevando a barra técnica do time sem perder o foco na entrega de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, TypeScript e arquitetura Serverless na AWS.
  • Realizar Code Reviews detalhados, garantindo a qualidade do código, segurança e a conformidade com os padrões arquiteturais definidos.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) para garantir a confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Atuar na investigação e resolução de incidentes críticos em produção (troubleshooting), bem como na otimização de performance de rotinas e banco de dados (NoSQL).
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a gestão de produto na viabilidade de novos requisitos e colaborar na estimativa de esforço das tarefas da squad.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando Node.js e TypeScript.
  • Domínio na construção de APIs RESTful e uso de frameworks como NestJS ou Express.
  • Vivência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria (AWS SQS/SNS ou similares).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (MongoDB), incluindo modelagem e otimização de performance.
  • Conhecimento sólido em serviços da AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3).
  • Prática habitual de escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Habilidade com Git, fluxos de Code Review e ambientes de CI/CD.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Docker e orquestração (Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou Serverless Framework).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic ou CloudWatch).
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) ou caches (Redis).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança de aplicação (OWASP).


Modelo de Contratação:

  • Regime: PJ + Benefícios.
  • Localização: 100% Remoto

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
Mandatory Skills Description:


  • 8+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally in financial services.
  • Strong experience in Java, Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, SQL or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, and performance tuning in Java.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot real-time trading issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.



Project Description:


  • Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc.


Responsibilities:


  • We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.
  • You will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, quants, and other technologists to build robust, scalable, and low-latency systems that support our investment and trading activities.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).
  • Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.
  • Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.
  • Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.
  • Provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: SDR - , , Brazil
description:
SDR — Centro de Tecnologia Capilar (CTC)

São Paulo | CLT | Presencial | 08h às 18h

Sobre o cargo

O SDR do CTC é responsável por conduzir leads provenientes de campanhas digitais até o agendamento da consulta médica, garantindo qualidade, aderência ao perfil e organização do fluxo comercial.

Atua na linha de frente da operação, com foco em agendamento, garantia do comparecimento na consulta medica , disciplina de processo e consistência de execução.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Atender leads oriundos de campanhas (Meta, Google e orgânico)
  • Realizar qualificação inicial conforme critérios definidos
  • Conduzir o lead até o agendamento da consulta médica
  • Registrar e atualizar informações no CRM (Kommo CRM)
  • Executar contatos via WhatsApp e ligação
  • Seguir scripts, fluxos e rotinas operacionais estabelecidas
  • Garantir organização do pipeline e follow-ups dentro do prazo
  • Trabalhar com alto volume de leads mantendo padrão de qualidade
Indicadores de performance (KPIs)
  • Taxa de conversão (lead → consulta agendada)
  • Volume de agendamentos realizados
  • Aderência ao processo (uso correto de CRM e etapas)
  • Tempo de resposta e cadência de follow-up
Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento, vendas ou SDR
  • Familiaridade com CRM e ferramentas de comunicação digital
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Capacidade de execução sob volume e metas claras
  • Organização e disciplina operacional
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com alto volume de leads
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas ou área da saúde
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento de metas
Perfil esperado
  • Consistência de entrega independentemente de variação de volume
  • Objetividade na condução de conversas
  • Responsabilidade direta sobre metas e indicadores
  • Capacidade de seguir e respeitar processos definidos
  • Interesse em evolução profissional com base em desempenho
Estrutura e modelo de trabalho
  • Contratação CLT
  • Horário fixo: 08h às 18h
  • Atuação presencial em São Paulo
  • Operação estruturada com processos, treinamento e acompanhamento
Remuneração
  • Salário fixo + variável por performance (3k + variável a combinar)
  • Metas e critérios de bonificação definidos internamente
Critérios de elegibilidade implícitos (avaliação durante o processo)
  • Clareza de comunicação
  • Capacidade de raciocínio sob pressão
  • Organização de pensamento
  • Velocidade de execução
  • Aderência a ambiente orientado por metas
Resumo funcional

Cargo voltado à execução comercial com foco em conversão e organização de pipeline, inserido em operação estruturada, com volume constante de leads e metas definidas.
